title: DNA spooling set-up
back: Chilled ethanol over the filtrate; white DNA threads at the boundary, spooled on a glass rod.

title: DNA isolation procedure
back: Wait without shaking, then spool the threads at the boundary.

title: Viva: role of detergent
back: Lipid cell and nuclear membranes break down and release DNA.

title: Viva: role of salt
back: With its charge neutralised, DNA clumps and comes out of solution more easily.

title: Viva: chilled ethanol
back: Chilled: lower solubility and slower DNA-breaking enzymes.

title: DNA isolation precautions
back: Stir gently after adding detergent; spool gently.

title: Soap, Salt, Spirit
back: Soap opens membranes, salt clumps DNA, cold spirit (ethanol) shows it as threads.

title: Papaya, Pineapple, Powder
back: Kitchen proteases that digest the proteins bound to DNA.
